captured_from.baseline_role: frozen source and partition-input commit; monolith source, definition fingerprints, collection, execution, selector and CI input all derive here
captured_from.guard_provenance_role: issue-start provenance only; current guard may evolve upstream and is validated by shape and issue-scoped diff, not this historical digest

digest_fields.aggregate: sha256 of the newline-joined list plus a trailing newline.
digest_fields.markers: pytest.mark.<name> decorators in source order, comma-joined.
digest_fields.oracle_digest: sha256 of per-function blocks joined by newlines: name, args_unparse, decorators space-joined, markers comma-joined, monkeypatch lines space-joined, ast_sha256.
digest_fields.rows: [owner, source_sha256, ast_sha256, markers, sha256(args_unparse), sha256(decorators space-joined), sha256(sorted monkeypatch lines)]
digest_fields.self_digest: sha256 of canonical JSON (sort_keys, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False) of every top-level key except `digests`.
digest_fields.source_sha256: sha256 of the definition fragment: starts at the first decorator (or the def), keeps a contiguous leading `#` run, drops that run when a blank line separates it, ends at node.end_lineno.
